title: Talikota 1565: The City of Victory Sacked for Six Months
summary: Tells how, in January fifteen sixty-five in southern India, four mutually hostile Deccan sultanates united against the Vijayanagara Empire, and how the regent Aliya Rama Raya, past eighty, was captured and beheaded at Talikota (Rakshasa-Tangadi). The episode runs from the diplomacy by which Rama Raya had set the sultans against one another for years, to the two commanders in his army who changed sides in the middle of the battle, and on to Vijayanagara, one of the richest cities in the world, being turned into an abandoned ruin by months of plunder.
